incidents.body:
Snowflake is currently experiencing an outage affecting some parts of their infrastructure (https://status.snowflake.com/incidents/fl9tkpj8d7hk). As a result, some Panther customers may experience query timeouts or slower performance on their instances. Real-time detection, alerting and ingestion should be unaffected.

We're actively monitoring the situation. We'll update this page as soon as we have more information.

Thanks for your patience.
incidents.title: Snowflake Outage Europe (Frankfurt) // eu-central-1

incidents.body:
Panther services have fully recovered from the regional AWS outage in us-east-1, and all systems are now operating normally.

During the incident, some customers experienced intermittent authentication errors and delays in data ingestion, enrichment, detection processing, and alert generation. All impacted components have since stabilized, and ingestion pipelines have caught up. No further action is required from customers.
incidents.title: AWS us-east-1 Service Outage
